body:
Reverse-direction port: plugins/adlc-codex has a real MCP server (plugins/adlc-codex/mcp/server.mjs + .mcp.json, wrapping @adlc/cli/lib/mcp-server.mjs's runStdioServer) and hook coverage for PreCompact/PostCompact/SubagentStart/SubagentStop that keeps ticket/rail context alive across compaction (plugins/adlc-codex/hooks/adlc-lifecycle.mjs's `context` mode, wired to those events in hooks.json). plugins/adlc-claude-code has neither: no MCP server at all, and its hooks.json only covers SessionStart/PreToolUse/PostToolUse/Stop — a Claude Code session that compacts mid-build loses the "ADLC current ticket: ... rail protection auto-active" context injection Codex gets automatically.

=== CONTRACT (write then gate) ===
Author .adlc/specs/claude-code-mcp-and-compaction.md before coding. Must pin: whether Claude Code's plugin.json needs new keys to register an MCP server (Claude Code's plugin manifest schema differs from Codex's — check the actual supported plugin.json MCP-registration shape before assuming Codex's `.mcp.json`-file-reference form transfers; this may require `mcpServers` inline in plugin.json or a separate file per Claude Code's real documented convention), which gate tools get exposed via MCP (mirror Codex's `.mcp.json` — same @adlc/cli mcp-server, so the exposed toolset should already match; confirm no Claude-Code-specific tool restrictions apply), and which Claude Code hook events actually fire around compaction (Claude Code's hooks.json vocabulary must be checked directly — do not assume PreCompact/PostCompact exist verbatim; if Claude Code's hook event names differ, the spec must name the real ones, and if Claude Code has no compaction-adjacent hook at all, say so and scope this deliverable down to whatever the platform actually supports, e.g. SessionStart re-injection only).

=== DELIVERABLES ===
1. MCP server registration. Add plugins/adlc-claude-code/mcp/server.mjs (mirroring plugins/adlc-codex/mcp/server.mjs: `import { runStdioServer } from '@adlc/cli/lib/mcp-server.mjs'; await runStdioServer();`) and wire it into plugins/adlc-claude-code/.claude-plugin/plugin.json per Claude Code's actual documented MCP-registration convention, per the spec's verified findings.
2. Compaction-context hook(s). Extend plugins/adlc-claude-code/hooks/adlc-hook.mjs (or add a focused new hook file) with a `context` mode reusing the same current-ticket-summary logic Codex's adlc-lifecycle.mjs already has (current ticket id/title/status/scope summary), wired to whichever real Claude Code hook events the spec identifies as compaction-adjacent.
3. Tests. Add plugins/adlc-claude-code/hooks/test coverage (or extend existing) asserting the context hook fires correctly and the MCP server module imports/exports cleanly (mirroring plugins/adlc-codex/mcp/test/protocol.test.mjs's coverage shape where applicable).
4. Docs. Update docs/integrations/claude-code.md and apps/docs/content/docs/integrations/claude-code.mdx to document the new MCP surface and compaction behavior; update plugins/adlc-claude-code/.claude-plugin/plugin.json's description if it undersells the plugin now that it exposes MCP tools.

=== ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA ===
- AC1: plugins/adlc-claude-code/mcp/server.mjs exists and is wired into the plugin manifest per Claude Code's real (verified, not assumed) MCP-registration convention. VERIFY: a smoke test analogous to scripts/claude-code-plugin-smoke.mjs asserting the MCP registration is present and the server module is importable.
- AC2: A ticket with declared rails produces the same context summary via Claude Code's new hook as Codex's adlc-lifecycle.mjs `context` mode produces for the same ticket state fixture. VERIFY: a new test comparing both hooks' output shape against a shared fixture, or documents why full parity isn't achievable per the spec.
- AC3: `adlc rails-guard --base main --ticket T52` passes; `npm test` passes at the root, including plugin smoke tests (`node scripts/codex-install-smoke.mjs .` and the Claude Code equivalent) unaffected.
- AC4: If the spec determines Claude Code has no true compaction-adjacent hook event, this AC is replaced during P1 by whatever the spec substitutes — the ticket must not silently claim compaction coverage the platform doesn't support.

=== OUT OF SCOPE ===
- Changing Codex's MCP server or its exposed toolset (source of truth stays there; Claude Code ports from it).
- T48-T51.
title: Give Claude Code's ADLC plugin an MCP server and compaction-aware context hooks (ported from Codex)
